_meanings:
‘Not told’, not otherwise mentioned by way of any
 of the other case-relations, such as {#apAdAna#} <ab>&c.</ab>; a name given to the
 indirect ({#gORa#}) object governed by verbs like {#duh, yAc#} <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>cf.</ab>
 {#anaBihitam akaTitaM karma#} and {#‘akaTitaM ca’#} <ls>P. I. 4. 51</ls>. In the
 sentence {#‘gAM payaH dogDi’ gAm#} is the indirect ({#gORa#}) object,
 and it could have taken the ablative ending.
